en: It was a winter evening, and the sky hung low and gloomy.
u.src: 冬日，傍晚，天色低沉。

en: I sat absentmindedly in the corner of an upbound second-class carriage departing from Yokosuka, quietly waiting for the whistle to signal departure.
u.src: 我在从横须贺发车的上行二等客车的角落里坐着出神，静静等着开车的笛声。

en: The lights in the train had been on for quite some time, and unusually, I was the only passenger in the carriage.
u.src: 车上的电灯亮了很久了，车厢里只有我一个乘客，很是难得。

en: Today was very different from usual: on the dim platform outside the window, there was not a single human figure, only a little dog shut in a cage that barked now and then.
u.src: 今天和往常差别很大，车窗外昏暗的站台上，除了一只被关在笼子里的小狗时不时嗷叫两声，一个人影也没有。

en: That lonely setting, if anything, suited my mood very well.
u.src: 寂寥的环境倒是和我的心境很是契合。

en: I felt exhausted in body and mind, and my mood was as gloomy as the low sky that seemed about to bring snow.
u.src: 我感觉身心俱疲，心情和即将下雪的低沉天空一样阴郁。

en: I sat listlessly in my seat with both hands tucked into my overcoat pockets, without even the strength to take out the evening paper.
u.src: 我无精打采的呆坐在座位上，双手揣在大衣兜里，连把晚报掏出来的力气都没有。

en: After a little while, the departure whistle sounded.
u.src: 过了一会儿，发车的笛声响了。

en: I leaned my head against the window frame behind me, stretched out slightly, and waited idly for the passenger car to leave the station.
u.src: 我把头倚在后面的窗框上，略微舒展了一下，无聊的等着客车出站。

en: But before the train had even begun to move,
u.src: 可是，车子还没移动，

en: together with the patter of low wooden clogs coming from the direction of the ticket gate, the conductor's irritated cursing, and the click of the door opening in the second-class carriage where I sat,
u.src: 伴随着检票口方向传来的一阵低齿木屐的“吧嗒吧嗒”，列车员不爽的咒骂声，以及我所在的二等车厢的门开门的“咯嗒”声，

en: a girl of about thirteen or fourteen rushed in, flustered and frantic.
u.src: 一个约莫十三四岁的姑娘仓皇失措的闯了进来。

en: At the same time, the train lurched hard once and slowly started off.
u.src: 与此同时，火车大力的颠簸了一下，缓缓的开了。

en: The platform pillars slipped backward one by one,
u.src: 站台的廊柱一根根向后面退去，

en: the water cart that seemed to have been forgotten,
u.src: 似乎被人忘记了的送水车，

en: and a porter in a red cap earnestly thanking someone in the carriage who had tipped him—
u.src: 戴红帽子的搬运夫诚恳的对车厢里给他小费的某人致谢——

en: everything receded backward like coal smoke blowing against the carriage window.
u.src: 所有的一切都像往车窗上吹过来的煤烟一般往后退去。

en: I let out a long breath and lit a cigarette,
u.src: 我长舒了一口气，点上一只烟卷，

en: then listlessly lifted my eyelids and glanced at the face of the girl sitting opposite me.
u.src: 无精打采的抬了抬眼睑，瞥了一眼坐在我对面姑娘的那张脸。

en: She must have been a girl from the countryside.
u.src: 那应该是个从乡下来的姑娘。

en: Her dry hair was tied in an icho-style bun, and across her excessively red cheeks ran lines of chapped cracks.
u.src: 干枯的头发绾成银杏髻，过分赤红的双颊上，还有一道道皲裂的伤痕。

en: Around her neck she wore a dirty pale green woolen scarf, which hung all the way down to her knees where a large bundle rested.
u.src: 脖子上戴着一条脏兮兮的淡绿色毛线围巾，围巾一直垂到放着一个大包袱的膝盖上。

en: The hands holding the bundle were covered with chilblains, and in one of them she carefully pinched a third-class ticket.
u.src: 抱着包袱的手上满是冻疮，手里还谨慎的捏着一张三等车票。

en: I found both the girl's vulgar face and her slovenly dress unpleasant.
u.src: 这位姑娘俗气的面像和邋遢的打扮都令我感到不快。

en: What irritated me even more was that she had mixed up the second-class and third-class carriages.
u.src: 更令我觉得烦躁的是，她连二等车厢和三等车厢都搞错了。

en: So after lighting a cigarette, I took an evening paper from my overcoat pocket and spread it on my knees to ignore the girl.
u.src: 因为这样，抽上烟之后，为了忽略这个姑娘，我从大衣兜里取出晚报摊在膝盖上。

en: Just then, the light falling on the evening paper suddenly changed from the sunlight outside the window to the electric light inside the carriage, and several indistinctly printed words on the page sprang into view.
u.src: 此时，照在晚报上的光线突然由窗外的阳光变成车厢内的电灯光，报纸上印刷不清楚的几个字突出的映入眼帘。

en: Without a doubt, the train had entered the first of the many tunnels on the Yokosuka Line.
u.src: 毫无疑问，火车驶进了横须贺线上众多隧道中的第一个隧道。

en: By the light, I glanced roughly over the contents of the evening paper,
u.src: 借着灯光，我大致溜了一圈晚报上的内容，

en: and everything printed there was just ordinary news,
u.src: 上面刊登的都是一些普通的事情，

en: things like peace negotiations, newlyweds, misconduct cases, obituaries, and so on,
u.src: 诸如媾和事件啦，新婚夫妇啦，渎职事件啦，讣告新闻等等，

en: and nothing in it could lift my spirits at all.
u.src: 没什么能让我提起精神劲儿来——

en: When the train entered the tunnel, I felt as though it were running backward,
u.src: 火车驶进隧道的时候，我觉得火车仿佛倒着开一样，

en: while at the same time I stared blankly at those tedious items of news.
u.src: 与此同时，盲目的看着这些无聊的消息。

en: But during that time, I could not help noticing the girl sitting primly opposite me,
u.src: 可是，这期间，我不由的注意到端坐在我对面的姑娘，

en: and the expression on her face was simply this wretched reality made human.
u.src: 她脸上的神气简直就是这糟糕现实的人格化。

en: The train passing through the tunnel,
u.src: 穿行在隧道里的火车，
邋里邋遢的乡下姑娘，

en: and the evening paper packed with commonplace news,
u.src: 以及充斥着平凡消息的晚报——

en: were these not the perfect symbol?
u.src: 这一切不就是最好的象征吗？

en: Were they not a symbol of life itself, inexplicable, dull, and ordinary?
u.src: 不就是难以解释、无聊平凡的人生的象征吗？

en: All of this left me bored to death and utterly disheartened,
u.src: 这一切都让我觉得百无聊赖，心灰意冷，

en: so I casually tossed the unread evening paper aside,
u.src: 我随手将没读完的晚报扔在一旁，

en: rested my head against the window frame again,
u.src: 又把头倚靠在窗框上，

en: closed my eyes as if I were dead, and dozed lazily.
u.src: 像要死了一样闭上眼睛，懒懒的打盹儿。

en: After a few minutes or so, I sensed that I had been intruded upon and had no choice but to open my eyes and look around.
u.src: 约莫过了几分钟，我觉察到自己受到了侵犯，不得不睁开眼观察周围。

en: The girl who had been sitting opposite me had somehow moved to my side and was stubbornly trying to open the train window beside me.
u.src: 对面的姑娘不知何时坐到我旁边了，并且固执的想要打开我旁边的车窗。

en: But the heavy glass window was not so easy to open.
u.src: 然而厚重的玻璃窗没有那么容易被打开。

en: Her chapped cheeks grew even redder, and the sound of her constant sniffling and faint panting forced its way into my ears.
u.src: 她那充斥着皲裂的脸颊更红了，她不停的吸着鼻涕声，微弱的喘息声，不由分辩的闯进我的耳际。

en: Her wretched appearance stirred a measure of pity in me.
u.src: 她这个糟糕的样子令我心中生出了几分同情。

en: In the vast dusk, only the dry grass on the ridges to either side could be seen, now pressing close before my eyes, which showed that the train was about to enter a tunnel.
u.src: 苍茫的暮色下，只能看见两旁山脊上干枯的草，此刻直逼到眼前，由此可见火车马上就要驶进隧道了。

en: I did not know why the girl wanted to open the train window.
u.src: 我不知道这姑娘为什么要打开车窗。

ja: れないということだけだった。
en: No, all I could say was that perhaps it was a passing whim of hers.
u.src: 不，我只能说，她也许是一时心血来潮的想法。

en: So, feeling displeased and hoping she would never manage to open the window, I watched coldly as those frostbitten hands struggled to force it open.
u.src: 就这样，我抱着不快的情绪，希望她永远也打不开车窗，冷眼旁观着那双生了冻疮的手费劲要打开车窗的情景。

en: Before long, with a piercing whistle, the train plunged into the tunnel; at the same moment, the glass window the girl had been straining to open dropped down with a clatter and opened.
u.src: 不一会儿，伴随着凄厉的鸣笛声，火车冲进了隧道；同时，姑娘费尽力气想要打开的那扇玻璃窗“咯噔”一声落了下来，开了。

en: Through the square opening, a cloud of dense black coal smoke and choking soot instantly poured in.
u.src: 方形窗洞，瞬间涌进来一股浓黑的煤烟和令人窒息的烟屑。

en: Before I could cover my face with my handkerchief, black smoke sprayed all over me, and since my throat had already been bothering me, I immediately choked and coughed until I could hardly breathe.
u.src: 我来不及用手绢捂住自己的脸，就被喷了一脸的黑烟，原本就嗓子不舒服的我，立马被呛得咳嗽的上气不接下气。

en: The girl, however, paid me no attention at all; she thrust her head out the window and stared motionlessly ahead along the train's path, while the wind blowing from the darkness sent the hair at her ginkgo-shaped coiffure flying freely.
u.src: 姑娘却根本不在乎我，她把头伸到窗外，一动不动的盯着火车行进的前方，黑暗中刮来的风将她绾着银杏髻的鬓发自在飞扬。

en: In the coal smoke and lamplight, the girl's figure could be seen clearly.
u.src: 煤烟和灯光里，姑娘的形影清晰可见。

en: At that moment, the world outside the window gradually brightened, and the different smells of earth, dry grass, and water blew coolly against my face; only then did I stop coughing, otherwise I would surely have cursed the girl and made her shut the window properly.
u.src: 这个时候，窗外渐渐明亮起来，泥土、枯草、水的不同气味凉凉的扑到我的脸上，我这才停下了咳嗽，否则，我一定会痛骂这个姑娘一顿，让她关好窗户。

en: But by then the train had already come safely out of the tunnel and was passing a railroad crossing on the edge of a bleak town among hills of withered grass.
u.src: 可是，这时候的火车已经平安驶出隧道，经过枯草山岭中凋敝城郊的道路岔道。

en: Beside the crossing, crude thatched roofs and tile-roofed houses stood packed closely together.
u.src: 道路岔道旁边，简陋的茅草屋顶和瓦房密密麻麻的排列着。

en: Perhaps the switchman was signaling, for an old white flag was waving in the air.
u.src: 约莫是扳道夫正在打信号吧，一面陈旧的白旗在空中摇曳。

en: Just after the train came out of the tunnel, at that very moment, I saw behind the fence by the switch,
u.src: 火车才驶出隧道，就在这个时候，我看见道岔的栅栏后面，

en: three boys standing shoulder to shoulder, all three of their cheeks flushed red.
u.src: 有三个男孩子并肩站在一起，三个人的脸蛋红扑扑的。

ja: しつけられているようだった。
en: None of them was tall; they looked as if they had been pressed down by the low-hanging sky.
u.src: 他们个子都不高，就像是被低沉的天空压的。

en: The colors of their mountain-country clothes were as dreary as the desolate scenery on the town outskirts.
u.src: 深山的衣服颜色，跟镇郊荒凉的景物一样惨淡。

en: They all looked up together and gazed at the passing train from a distance, raising their hands in unison,
u.src: 他们一起抬头远望火车经过，齐齐举起手，

en: and shrieked at the tops of their voices, though I could not make out what they were shouting.
u.src: 扯着嗓子尖叫，听不明白喊得到底是什么意思。

en: At that instant, the girl who had thrust her head out the window stretched out her frostbitten hands,
u.src: 这一刹那，把头伸向窗外的姑娘，伸开满是冻疮的手，

en: waved them from side to side, and five or six oranges, turned a joyful gold by the warm sunlight,
u.src: 左右摇摆，令温暖的阳光映照成令人欢喜的金色的五六个橘子，

en: suddenly fell from the window toward the heads of the children watching the train depart.
u.src: 突然从窗口往目送火车离开的孩子们头上落下。

en: I held my breath without meaning to, and at once I understood.
u.src: 我情不自禁的屏住呼吸，立刻了然。

en: The girl was probably going away to work as a maid, and had thrown a few oranges she had tucked inside her coat out the window,
u.src: 约莫是姑娘要去当女佣，从窗口扔出去几个揣在怀里的橘子，

en: as a treat for her younger brothers, who had come all the way to the crossing to see her off.
u.src: 犒劳专门来岔道旁送别她的弟弟们。

en: Dusk spread dim and vast, shrouding the fork in the road on the outskirts of town,
u.src: 暮色苍茫，笼罩着镇郊的道路岔口，

en: the chatter of the three children, crying out like little birds,
u.src: 三个孩子叽叽喳喳如鸟儿似的叫声，

en: and the bright color of the oranges the girl had thrown over their heads, all of it,
u.src: 和姑娘向他们头上丢过去的橘子的鲜亮颜色——这所有的一切，

en: vanished from outside the train window in a single moment.
u.src: 片刻之间就从车窗外消失了。

en: But that scene remained deep in my heart, leaving me almost unable to breathe.
u.src: 但是这幅画面却深深的留在了我的心里，让我几乎喘不过气来。

en: I found myself becoming happy in spite of myself.
u.src: 我发现自己情不自禁的愉悦起来。

en: I lifted my head and looked at the girl again, as though I were seeing a different person.
u.src: 我抬起头，像看另外一个人似的重新打量那个姑娘。

en: Before I knew it, the girl had already returned to the seat opposite me,
u.src: 不知何时，姑娘已经回到我对面的位置上了，

en: and above her pale green scarf were still her cheeks covered with chapped cracks,
u.src: 淡绿色的围巾上面依然是她那布满皲裂的双颊，

en: while in the hand holding the large bundle she still carefully pinched that third class ticket.
u.src: 抱着大包袱的手里仍然谨慎的捏着那张三等车票。

en: Only then did I slightly forget the exhaustion of body and mind, and that incomprehensible, unbearably tedious life.
u.src: 到了这时候，我才稍微忘记身心俱疲，和那难以理解的、百无聊赖的人生。
一九一九年 四月
